nodes.speaker: Gnome
nodes.text: You've found The Garden. Few do by accident.

nodes.speaker: Gnome
nodes.text: These lands are old. The things that grow here... not all of them are plants. What brings you west of the Outskirts?

nodes.speaker: Gnome
nodes.text: Good. The Garden has need of someone willing to get their hands dirty. Check the Quest Plaza — the board has fresh notices.

nodes.speaker: Gnome
nodes.text: The Marches remember those who act. And those who hesitate.

nodes.speaker: Gnome
nodes.text: Back again. The Garden grows on people.
